name: arm_base_set_angle
description: Set the arm joint 1: base rotation (turn the whole arm) to an absolute angle in degrees. Range -166.0° to 166.0°; at home it is 0.0°.

degrees.description: Target angle in degrees.

name: arm_base_move_left
description: Using only the arm joint 1: base rotation (turn the whole arm): move the hand to the robot's left. Moves it by the given number of degrees from where it is now (stops at its limits).

degrees.description: How far to move, in degrees.

name: curl_thumb
description: Curl the whole thumb closed (all its joints, as in a fist). Other fingers are not moved.

name: straighten_thumb
description: Straighten / open the whole thumb fully. Other fingers are not moved.

name: set_thumb_curl
description: Set how curled the thumb is: 0 = fully straight, 1 = fully curled, 0.5 = half way.

name: curl_index
description: Curl the whole index finger closed (all its joints, as in a fist). Other fingers are not moved.

name: straighten_index
description: Straighten / open the whole index finger fully. Other fingers are not moved.

name: set_index_curl
description: Set how curled the index finger is: 0 = fully straight, 1 = fully curled, 0.5 = half way.

name: curl_middle
description: Curl the whole middle finger closed (all its joints, as in a fist). Other fingers are not moved.

name: straighten_middle
description: Straighten / open the whole middle finger fully. Other fingers are not moved.

name: set_middle_curl
description: Set how curled the middle finger is: 0 = fully straight, 1 = fully curled, 0.5 = half way.

name: curl_ring
description: Curl the whole ring finger closed (all its joints, as in a fist). Other fingers are not moved.

name: straighten_ring
description: Straighten / open the whole ring finger fully. Other fingers are not moved.

name: set_ring_curl
description: Set how curled the ring finger is: 0 = fully straight, 1 = fully curled, 0.5 = half way.

name: curl_little
description: Curl the whole little finger closed (all its joints, as in a fist). Other fingers are not moved.

name: straighten_little
description: Straighten / open the whole little finger fully. Other fingers are not moved.

name: set_little_curl
description: Set how curled the little finger is: 0 = fully straight, 1 = fully curled, 0.5 = half way.

name: spread_fingers_apart
description: Spread the four fingers apart sideways (fan the hand out), using each finger's knuckle side-swing joint.

name: bring_fingers_together
description: Bring the four fingers back together side by side (no gaps).

name: hand_pose_scissors
description: Shape the hand into the 'scissors' pose: index and middle extended, others curled ('scissors' / peace sign). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_rock
description: Shape the hand into the 'rock' pose: a fist (rock-paper-scissors 'rock'). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_paper
description: Shape the hand into the 'paper' pose: a flat open hand (rock-paper-scissors 'paper'). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_open_hand
description: Shape the hand into the 'open hand' pose: every finger and the thumb straight. Use it to let go of / release / drop a held object once it has been lowered onto the table or target zone, or to open the hand before grasping. Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_close_hand
description: Shape the hand into the 'close hand' pose: a full fist: all fingers and thumb curled. Use it to grab, grasp and hold an object once the open palm is resting on it, before lifting it; this is how the hand picks things up. Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_point
description: Shape the hand into the 'point' pose: index finger extended, the rest curled (pointing). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_two_finger_pinch
description: Shape the hand into the 'two finger pinch' pose: thumb and index fingertips pressed together (precision pinch). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_three_finger_pinch
description: Shape the hand into the 'three finger pinch' pose: thumb, index and middle fingertips together (tripod pinch). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_parallel_extension
description: Shape the hand into the 'parallel extension' pose: fingers straight but bent at the knuckles, thumb opposite (flat clamp). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_grasp_sphere
description: Shape the hand into the 'grasp sphere' pose: fingers and thumb wrapped as around a ball; can grab a ball the palm is resting on. Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_pre_grasp
description: Shape the hand into the 'pre grasp' pose: hand shaped ready to grasp (partially open). Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_grasp_soft
description: Shape the hand into the 'grasp soft' pose: a gentle wrap grasp to hold an object the palm is on. Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: hand_pose_grasp_hard
description: Shape the hand into the 'grasp hard' pose: a firm wrap grasp to hold an object the palm is on. Optionally apply it to only some fingers.

name: move_palm_to_position
description: Move the palm centre to an exact [x, y, z] point in metres (world frame; table top is at z=0.4, +x is away from the robot, +y is the robot's left). Optionally choose which way the palm faces.

palm_facing.description: Direction the palm faces (default: keep current).

name: move_palm_forward
description: Move the whole hand forward in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (move the hand forward, away from the robot base).

name: move_palm_back
description: Move the whole hand back in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (move the hand back toward the robot base).

name: move_palm_left
description: Move the whole hand left in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (move the hand to the robot's left).

name: move_palm_right
description: Move the whole hand right in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (move the hand to the robot's right).

name: move_palm_up
description: Move the whole hand up in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (raise the hand). Use it to lift a grasped object off the table, or to move the hand away after releasing an object.

name: move_palm_down
description: Move the whole hand down in a straight line by a distance in centimetres, keeping its orientation (lower the hand). Use it to lower the hand, or a held object, toward the table.

name: turn_palm_to_face_forward
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces forward (to the forward).

name: turn_palm_to_face_back
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces back (to the back).

name: turn_palm_to_face_left
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces left (to the left).

name: turn_palm_to_face_right
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces right (to the right).

name: turn_palm_to_face_up
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces up (up toward the sky).

name: turn_palm_to_face_down
description: Rotate the hand in place so the palm faces down (toward the table).

name: move_palm_above_red_cube
description: Move the hand, palm facing down, to hover above the red cube (box). Use this to approach the red cube before grasping it.

height_cm.description: Height of the palm centre above the object's centre.

name: lower_palm_onto_red_cube
description: Lower the hand straight down so the palm centre is at the red cube (grasping position), keeping the current orientation. Close the hand afterwards to grab it.

height_offset_cm.description: Stop this far above the object's centre.

name: move_palm_above_blue_ball
description: Move the hand, palm facing down, to hover above the blue ball (sphere). Use this to approach the blue ball before grasping it.

height_cm.description: Height of the palm centre above the object's centre.

name: lower_palm_onto_blue_ball
description: Lower the hand straight down so the palm centre is at the blue ball (grasping position), keeping the current orientation. Close the hand afterwards to grab it.

height_offset_cm.description: Stop this far above the object's centre.

name: move_palm_above_green_cylinder
description: Move the hand, palm facing down, to hover above the green cylinder (cylinder). Use this to approach the green cylinder before grasping it.

height_cm.description: Height of the palm centre above the object's centre.

name: lower_palm_onto_green_cylinder
description: Lower the hand straight down so the palm centre is at the green cylinder (grasping position), keeping the current orientation. Close the hand afterwards to grab it.

height_offset_cm.description: Stop this far above the object's centre.

name: move_palm_above_target_zone
description: Carry the hand (and anything it holds) to hover above the yellow target zone, palm facing down.

name: lower_palm_to_target_zone
description: Lower the hand straight down over the target zone to place a held object on the table there. Open the hand afterwards to release it.

height_cm.description: Palm height above the table when stopping.

name: get_robot_state
description: Read the full robot state: palm position and orientation, fingertip positions, finger curl, wrist and arm joint angles, and every object's position, contacts and status.

name: wait
description: Do nothing for a moment and let the scene settle.

name: move_to_home_pose
description: Move the arm and hand back to the ready pose (palm down above the table, hand open) without touching the objects.

name: reset_scene
description: Reset everything: robot to the home pose and all objects back to their start positions.

name: get_red_cube_state
description: Read the red cube's state: position, how high it is lifted, which hand parts touch it, whether it is held and whether it is in the target zone.

name: get_blue_ball_state
description: Read the blue ball's state: position, how high it is lifted, which hand parts touch it, whether it is held and whether it is in the target zone.

name: get_green_cylinder_state
description: Read the green cylinder's state: position, how high it is lifted, which hand parts touch it, whether it is held and whether it is in the target zone.

name: camera_snapshot_overview
description: Take a picture of the scene from the 'overview' camera (returns a PNG image).
